verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.vast.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of doc pages. Docs pages are served as raw .md URLs, a dedicated agents guide documents the `vastai` agent skill for AI coding assistants, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is published. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs effectively, and no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
